$comment: Which studies the README's results table is allowed to draw from. Everything in bench/raw/ is published; this file decides what counts as a HEADLINE claim. A single batch is not enough - see Amendment 3 in bench/preregistration/001-first-study.md, where the same configuration measured -49% in one batch and +24% in another. Studies listed here must be replicated or explicitly labelled.

excluded.partB2-body-length: body-length experiment on one model, and the batch that showed the variance problem
excluded.review-gpt-5-6-sol: single un-replicated batch; superseded by the effort sweep. Published as data, not as a headline
excluded.review-gpt-5-6-terra: single un-replicated batch that contradicts partB2 on the same body; the reason the headline waits
